events.title: Will-o'-the-Wisp
events.description: A mysterious blue-green light dances through the mist, beckoning you deeper into the bog...

results.text: The light leads you to a pocket of rare swamp gas! You carefully collect some.
The light leads you to a hidden clearing filled with restorative herbs! Your stamina, hunger, and thirst are replenished.
The light was a trap! You stumble into a hidden sinkhole and exhaust yourself climbing out.
You wisely keep to the solid path. The light fades into the fog.

events.title: Quicksand Pit!
events.description: The ground beneath you starts to give way! The mud is pulling you down...

results.text: You manage to pull yourself free, but you're exhausted!
Your thrashing uncovers some bog iron buried in the muck! You pull yourself free with a prize.
Grabbing a vine overhead, you swing free — and notice a murky pearl in the mud!

events.title: The Swamp Hermit
events.description: An old hermit emerges from a rickety shack hidden among the cypress trees. 'I've got wares, and hot stew...'

results.text: The hermit trades you some potent leech extract! 'Good for what ails ya,' he mutters.
The hermit hands you a pouch of coins! 'Been saving these. Take 'em before the swamp does.'
The hermit offers you some hot stew. Your hunger and thirst are completely sated, and you feel energized!
The hermit shrugs and disappears back into his shack. The swamp swallows the silence.

events.title: Alligator Nest
events.description: You spot a mound of vegetation and mud — an alligator's nest! There seem to be interesting items mixed in with the debris...

results.text: You grab a moss-covered relic from the nest before the mother returns!
The mother alligator returns! Prepare for battle!
You back away slowly. Some things are better left undisturbed.

events.title: Thick Fog Rolls In
events.description: An impenetrable fog descends on the swamp. Visibility drops to nearly zero...

results.text: Stumbling through the fog, you trip over some cypress knees — perfect crafting material!
The fog disoriented you. You wander in circles before finding your way.
You rest while the fog clears. The brief pause refreshes you.

events.title: Stampede!
events.description: The ground rumbles! A massive herd of wildebeest thunders across the plain directly towards you!

results.text: You dodge behind a boulder! As the herd passes, you find horn fragments left behind.
You barely make it behind cover! The dust cloud leaves you coughing and drained.
Safe in the acacia tree, you find an abandoned weaver bird nest!

events.title: Watering Hole Gathering
events.description: You discover a watering hole where dozens of animals have gathered. The scene is both beautiful and tense...

results.text: While watching, you notice a piece of amber glinting in the mud!
A predator spots you from across the water! It charges!
The cool water refreshes you. You feel rejuvenated.

events.title: Traveling Trader
events.description: A dusty caravan appears on the horizon. The trader waves you over with a warm smile.

results.text: The trader shares some baobab fruit from their journey!
The trader is in a generous mood and gives you coins for your company!
You trade stories and receive some medicinal acacia bark.
The trader tips their hat and continues on their way.

events.title: Dust Devil
events.description: A spinning column of dust races across the open ground, picking up debris in its path!

results.text: The dust devil deposits some beautiful ostrich feathers at your feet!
You get caught in the whirlwind and stumble around dizzy!
Sheltering behind a termite mound, you find some useful dry grass.

events.title: Shimmering Mirage
events.description: The heat haze warps your vision. You see what appears to be a lush oasis ahead... or is it?

results.text: The mirage fades, but where it was you find a crystallized shard of desert glass!
It was just a mirage. You've wasted precious energy chasing nothing.
It's real! A hidden oasis with a treasure chest half-buried in the sand!
You've seen enough mirages to know better. You press on.

events.title: Sandstorm Incoming!
events.description: The sky darkens as a wall of sand races across the desert. You need to act fast!

results.text: You duck into a rock formation and find beautiful desert rose crystals!
You weather the storm in a shallow cave. A bit sandy but safe.
Digging into the sand, you find scarab shells preserved beneath the surface!
The sand blasts you mercilessly. You're exhausted when it passes.

events.title: Scorpion Den
events.description: You've stumbled upon a den of desert scorpions! Their tails glow under the moonlight...

results.text: With steady hands, you extract some valuable scorpion venom!
Ouch! A scorpion stings you! The venom drains your energy.
You slowly back away. Not worth the risk.

events.title: Ancient Ruins
events.description: Half-buried sandstone pillars emerge from a dune. This was once a great structure...

results.text: You find an inscribed sandstone slab with ancient markings!
A hidden chamber contains a cache of ancient gold coins!
The ruins are guarded! A creature emerges from the shadows!
You sketch the ruins and pick up an interesting bleached bone nearby.

events.title: Sudden Blizzard
events.description: Snow begins falling heavily. Within minutes, a full blizzard engulfs the area!

results.text: While building shelter under a pine, you find frozen sap crystals!
You survive the blizzard but it takes a toll on your stamina.
Pressing on, you find a tuft of snowshoe hare fur caught on a branch!
The blizzard is relentless. You barely make it through.

events.title: Wolf Pack Sighting
events.description: Yellow eyes gleam from the tree line. A wolf pack has spotted you...

results.text: The wolves respect your courage and leave. You find claw marks on a nearby tree — a trophy!
The alpha charges! Prepare to defend yourself!
Backing away, you find a shed elk antler — the wolves' prey left this behind.

events.title: Abandoned Cabin
events.description: A moss-covered cabin sits in a clearing. Smoke once rose from its chimney, but it's been empty for years...

results.text: Inside, you find a birch bark scroll with what appears to be a map!
Under a loose floorboard, you discover a stash of coins!
The cabin's shelves hold jars of preserved pine resin!
You respect the former owner's privacy and move on.

events.title: Rockslide!
events.description: Rocks begin tumbling from above! The mountainside is unstable!

results.text: You dodge the rocks and find some beautiful granite shards in the debris!
A rock clips your shoulder! You make it to safety but you're bruised.
The rockslide reveals a vein of iron ore! You chip off a chunk.
Your pack takes the hits. You're shaken but safe.

events.title: Eagle's Nest
events.description: High on a cliff ledge, you spot an eagle's nest. Something glints among the sticks and feathers...

results.text: You reach the nest and find pristine eagle feathers!
The eagle collected a beautiful quartz crystal! Finders keepers.
The mother eagle returns and drives you off! You scramble back down.
Looking up, you notice a rare edelweiss growing on the cliff face!

events.title: Hidden Hot Spring
events.description: Steam rises from a hidden pool among the rocks. A natural hot spring!

results.text: The mineral-rich water soothes your aching muscles. You feel fully refreshed!
The therapeutic waters heal your team's minor wounds!
You bottle some of the mineral-rich spring water!

events.title: Shipwreck on Shore
events.description: The remains of an old ship lie scattered across the beach. Barnacles cover its hull...

results.text: In the captain's quarters, you find a chest of gold doubloons!
Beautiful sea glass is scattered throughout the wreck!
Something living has made its home in the wreck! It attacks!
You collect some useful driftwood from around the wreck.

events.title: Rogue Wave!
events.description: A massive wave is building on the horizon and heading straight for the shore!

results.text: From the cliffs, you watch the wave deposit a beautiful pearl on the rocks!
You sprint uphill just in time. The wave crashes below.
The wave soaks you but washes up some interesting shells!
The wave knocks you off your feet! You're soaked and exhausted.

events.title: Message in a Bottle
events.description: A glass bottle bobs in the shallow water. There's something inside...

results.text: It's a treasure map! Following the clues, you dig up a small chest.
Inside is a collection of perfectly preserved sand dollars!
It's just a soggy love letter. Sweet, but not useful.
You send the bottle back to sea. Maybe someone else will find it.

events.title: Volcanic Tremor!
events.description: The ground shakes violently! Cracks appear in the earth, and steam hisses from below!

results.text: In the fresh cracks, you spot a brilliant fire opal!
Geothermal minerals have been pushed to the surface!
Steam bursts from a crack and scalds you! You retreat quickly.
As you flee, you scoop up some fresh volcanic ash — useful for crafting!

events.title: Fresh Lava Flow
events.description: A river of glowing lava slowly advances down the mountainside. The heat is intense!

results.text: At the edge of the flow, the cooling lava forms beautiful obsidian!
The heat is unbearable! You manage to grab some lava rock but you're parched.
Taking the long way, you find some cooled basalt fragments.

events.title: Ember Moth Swarm
events.description: A cloud of glowing ember moths rises from the volcanic vents, their wings shimmering with heat...

results.text: You gently capture some ember moth wings — they glow with residual heat!
The moths' heat singes you! You back off with minor burns.
The beautiful display fills you with wonder. You feel energized.

events.title: Cave-In!
events.description: The ceiling groans ominously! Small rocks begin to fall!

results.text: The collapse reveals a hidden chamber with a stunning crystal geode!
You make it through but the dust and effort drain you.
Fallen stalactite fragments litter the ground. You collect some.

events.title: Underground Lake
events.description: Your flashlight reveals a vast underground lake. Bioluminescent organisms make the water glow an eerie blue...

results.text: You find scales from the blind cave fish — prized by collectors!
You harvest some glowing phosphorescent moss from the lake shore!
Something massive stirs in the depths! It surfaces!
You bottle some of the pure underground water.

events.title: Ancient Cave Paintings
events.description: The cave walls are covered in ancient paintings depicting animals and mysterious symbols...

results.text: Near the paintings, you discover an ancient fossil embedded in the wall!
The symbols reveal a hidden alcove containing ancient treasures!
You find a perfectly smooth echo stone used by the ancient painters.
While pressing paper to the wall, you notice rare cave mushrooms growing nearby!

events.title: Lost Pet
events.description: A concerned citizen approaches you. 'Have you seen my pet? It escaped into the alley!'

results.text: You find the pet hiding behind a dumpster! The grateful owner rewards you.
Following the trail, you find something else entirely... and it's hostile!
You wish them well and continue exploring.

events.title: Mysterious Dumpster
events.description: A dumpster behind an electronics shop has its lid slightly ajar. Something's gleaming inside...

results.text: Jackpot! Perfectly good circuit boards someone threw away!
Lots of useful scrap metal in here!
A raccoon stashed a shiny trinket collection in here!
Some treasures aren't worth the smell.

events.title: Street Performer
events.description: A street performer plays a haunting melody on a strange instrument. Animals seem drawn to the music...

results.text: The music soothes your soul. You feel revitalized!
The performer gives you an old rusty key as thanks. 'It opens something special,' they wink.
You nod appreciatively and continue on your way.

events.title: Abandoned Construction Site
events.description: An old construction site sits behind rusty fencing. Equipment and materials lie scattered about...

results.text: You find heaps of salvageable scrap metal!
Someone left their tools behind. You find coins in a lunch box.
Feral animals have made this their territory! They're not happy to see you!
You find an old newspaper blowing in the wind near the fence.

events.title: Northern Lights
events.description: The sky erupts in shimmering curtains of green, purple, and pink. The aurora borealis dances overhead!

results.text: The light seems to crystallize in the cold air — you capture an aurora fragment!
The magnificent display fills you with renewed energy!
You sit and watch, mesmerized. The beauty of nature restores your spirit.

events.title: The Ice Cracks!
events.description: A loud crack echoes across the ice! The surface beneath you is splitting!

results.text: You leap to safety! The broken ice reveals beautiful crystals underneath.
You barely make it! The freezing water splashes your legs.
Moving slowly, you reach safety and extract a permafrost core from the edge.

events.title: Whale Song
events.description: A deep, resonant song fills the water. A pod of whales is passing through...

results.text: The pod leads you to their feeding grounds where you find shed whale bone.
Their massive tails churn up ocean foam with rare mineral essence!
The haunting melody fills you with peace and wonder.

events.title: Ocean Storm
events.description: Dark clouds gather rapidly. Lightning flashes across the water as waves grow taller!

results.text: The storm churns up a rare nautilus shell from the deep!
The storm batters you relentlessly. You endure but you're weakened.
Sheltering under a reef overhang, you scrape off some barnacle clusters.

events.title: Bioluminescent Trench
events.description: The walls of an underwater trench pulse with bioluminescent life. The deep glows with alien beauty...

results.text: You harvest some concentrated bioluminescent gel from the trench walls!
At extreme depth, you find a rare pressure crystal!
Something enormous stirs in the darkness below... it rises toward you!
You collect some tube worm casings from the trench rim.

events.title: Hydrothermal Vent
events.description: A column of superheated water erupts from the sea floor. Strange life thrives around it...

results.text: You collect mineral deposits from around the vent — rich in rare elements!
You chip off some black smoker sulfide — a valuable find!
A giant squid passes by, leaving behind a cloud of ink you collect!

events.title: Feeding Frenzy!
events.description: Schools of fish suddenly erupt in a feeding frenzy! The reef comes alive with activity!

results.text: The chaos yields dropped scales from parrotfish!
A predator follows the frenzy — and targets you!
The churning water deposits fine reef sand near you.

events.title: Sunken Treasure Chest
events.description: Encrusted with coral and barnacles, an ancient treasure chest sits wedged between reef formations!

results.text: Inside you find a pile of ancient gold coins preserved by the sea!
The chest contains a magnificent conch shell — a rare prize!
Opening the chest disturbs a territorial moray eel!
You gently harvest a piece of the coral growing on the chest.

events.title: Natural Canopy Bridge
events.description: Intertwined vines form a natural bridge high in the canopy. What treasures lie above the forest floor?

results.text: High in the canopy, you find rare orchids blooming in the mist!
A toucan's roosting spot yields some colorful feathers!
The vine bridge snaps! You fall but catch yourself. Your arms ache.
The base of the canopy trees yields some strong strangler fig roots.

events.title: Monsoon Downpour!
events.description: The sky opens up with torrential rain! Rivers form instantly on the forest floor!

results.text: Bromeliads fill with fresh rainwater — you collect some!
The rain cools you off in the humid jungle. Refreshing!
Rain washes nectar down from the canopy flowers — you catch some!
The downpour soaks everything. You're chilled and tired.

events.title: Poison Dart Frogs
events.description: Brilliantly colored frogs hop along the forest floor. Beautiful but deadly...

results.text: With extreme care, you extract some poison dart frog mucus — alchemists pay well for this!
You accidentally touch one! The mild toxin makes you dizzy.
While sketching, you notice kapok fibers drifting nearby.

events.title: Sea Otter Family
events.description: A family of sea otters floats among the kelp, cracking shells on their bellies and playing in the fronds!

results.text: The otters leave behind a whisker as they swim off — a lucky find!
The otters' discarded shells include some beautiful abalone!
Watching the otters play warms your heart. You feel refreshed!

events.title: Strong Current!
events.description: A powerful underwater current sweeps through the kelp forest, bending the giant stalks!

results.text: The current tears loose some giant kelp fronds — you grab them!
The current slams you into a rocky outcrop. Ouch!
Clinging to a kelp stalk, you find a detached holdfast below.

events.title: Rising Tide
events.description: The water is rising fast! The tangled mangrove roots become submerged as the tide sweeps in.

results.text: From your perch, you pluck some mangrove seed pods!
The aerial roots you're clinging to shed some useful fiber!
Mudskippers scatter, leaving behind some shiny scales!
The murky water soaks you and something nips your ankle!

events.title: Oyster Bed Discovery
events.description: The roots are covered in clusters of wild oysters! This could be a valuable harvest...

results.text: You pry off several oysters — one even contains a small pearl!
You cut yourself on a sharp shell. Minor wound, but it stings!
You snap off a mangrove root as a marker to find this spot again.

events.title: Narwhal Surfacing!
events.description: A pod of narwhals surfaces through a crack in the sea ice! Their spiral tusks glint in the polar light.

results.text: A small chip of narwhal ivory lies on the ice edge — naturally shed!
The narwhals' feeding stirs up krill near the surface!
The majestic sight fills you with awe and energy.

events.title: Ice Cave
events.description: An ice cave glows with ethereal blue light. The walls are translucent and ancient...

results.text: Deep inside, you find an ancient iceberg fragment with trapped air bubbles!
Frost coral grows on the cave walls — you carefully harvest some!
The cave collapses partially! You escape but the cold saps your energy.
Beautiful ice shards litter the cave entrance.

events.title: Flash Flood!
events.description: The river swells rapidly! Muddy water rushes downstream carrying branches and debris!

results.text: The flood deposits a waterlogged scroll at your feet!
Debris from the flood includes some useful driftwood!
Clinging to a log, you scoop up some river clay from the churning waters!
The current pulls you downstream before you can climb out!

events.title: Old Fisherman
events.description: An old fisherman sits on the bank, line in the water. He tips his hat as you approach.

results.text: The fisherman shares his catch — some fresh salmon roe!
He shows you where a kingfisher nests. You find a fallen feather!
He buys some supplies from you and pays in coins.
He nods back. Sometimes the best conversations are silent.

events.title: Beaver Dam
events.description: A massive beaver dam blocks the river. The engineering is impressive! Debris is piled high...

results.text: Smooth river stones are embedded in the dam — perfect for crafting!
The dam's quiet pool holds freshwater mussels!
You gather river moss growing at the dam's base.

events.title: Morning Mist Mystery
events.description: The lake is shrouded in thick morning mist. Strange shapes seem to move beneath the surface...

results.text: Your feet touch something smooth — a beautiful freshwater pearl!
You find a patch of large lily pads with medicinal properties!
The mist parts to reveal something large just below the surface!
As the mist burns off, dragonflies emerge — you find shed wings!

events.title: Wishing Well
events.description: An ancient stone wishing well sits at the lake's edge. The water inside glows faintly...

results.text: The well glows brightly! You feel completely rejuvenated!
Your coin disturbs the bottom, and older coins float up!
The well's magic washes over your team, healing their wounds!
The water tastes pure and ancient. You feel refreshed.
The water is stagnant! Your stomach turns.

events.title: Mammoth Remains!
events.description: The permafrost has thawed enough to reveal the preserved remains of an ancient mammoth!

results.text: You extract a perfectly preserved fossil from the mammoth site!
Preserved ivory and ancient artifacts! This is worth a fortune to researchers!
Frozen amber with ancient insects trapped inside!
Researchers reward you for reporting the discovery!

events.title: Caribou Migration
events.description: Thousands of caribou thunder past! The great migration is underway!

results.text: The herd leads you to rich caribou moss feeding grounds!
Musk oxen graze at the migration's edge — you find shed wool!
After the herd passes, you find tundra berries they uncovered.

events.title: Temple Ruins
events.description: Vine-covered stone walls emerge from the dense jungle. An ancient temple lies hidden here...

results.text: The altar holds ancient golden offerings! You carefully take some.
Jaguar claw marks on the walls — you take a stone fragment as proof!
The temple's guardian emerges! Prepare for battle!
You harvest some strong jungle vines growing on the temple walls.

events.title: Hidden Waterfall
events.description: Following the sound of rushing water, you discover a magnificent hidden waterfall!

results.text: Behind the waterfall, passion fruit grows wild on the cliff!
A hidden cave behind the falls contains a treasure cache!
The waterfall's force pushes you under. You swallow water.
The mist from the waterfall cools you down. Pure bliss!

events.title: Macaw Flock
events.description: A flock of brilliant macaws erupts from the treetops in a rainbow of color!

results.text: Their roosting tree is covered in shed feathers — gorgeous!
The macaws were eating cocoa pods — some are left behind!
The flock leads you to a monkey nut tree!

events.title: The Ancient One
events.description: You stand before a redwood so massive it blocks the sky. This tree is thousands of years old...

results.text: Inside the hollow trunk, you find amber preserved for millennia!
The inner bark is thick and rich — perfect for crafting!
Something has made its den inside! It's not pleased about visitors!
Ancient moss covers the base — you collect some carefully.

events.title: Coastal Fog
events.description: Thick fog rolls through the redwood forest. Water drips from every surface...

results.text: The fog brings out the banana slugs! You collect some of their trail.
The misty forest floor is covered in lush ferns!
Tiny redwood cones litter the foggy ground.

events.title: Prairie Fire!
events.description: Smoke rises on the horizon! A wildfire races across the dry grassland!

results.text: While digging, you uncover flint chips — useful for tools!
The smoke inhalation and effort drain you, but you're safe.
The fire's edge reveals burned but useful grass bundles.
You barely outrun the flames! You're exhausted.

events.title: Bison Herd
events.description: A massive herd of bison grazes peacefully on the open plain. They eye you warily...

results.text: The bison tolerate your presence. You collect some shed fur!
A protective bull charges! Prepare yourself!
While watching, you gather beautiful wildflowers from the prairie.

events.title: Tornado on the Horizon!
events.description: A funnel cloud drops from the dark sky! The tornado tears across the open plains!

results.text: In the ditch, you find wind-polished stones — smooth as glass!
The wind roars overhead. You're safe but shaken.
The tornado's path reveals a coyote den — you find a shed fang!
Way too close! The wind flings debris at you!

events.title: Bird Sanctuary
events.description: Hundreds of wading birds fill the wetlands — herons, egrets, ibises — a natural sanctuary!

results.text: You find beautiful bittern feathers in the reeds!
The peaceful scene restores your spirit.
Among the nesting areas, marsh marigolds bloom abundantly!
A protective crane doesn't appreciate your snooping! It attacks!

events.title: Wetland Sinkhole
events.description: The ground gives way to reveal a muddy sinkhole! Old relics peek out from the muck...

results.text: Rich wetland peat lines the sinkhole — valuable for gardening!
Ancient snail shells are embedded in the muck!
You cut cattail stalks to mark the hazard.

events.title: Shooting Star!
events.description: A brilliant streak of light crosses the night sky! It seems to land nearby...

results.text: You find the meteorite! A rare space rock worth a fortune!
The meteorite has shattered into iron-rich fragments!
You search but can't find where it landed. The stars mock you.
You close your eyes and wish for strength. You feel empowered!
Nothing visible happens. But who knows what fate has in store?

events.title: Injured Animal
events.description: You find a wild animal caught in an old trap. It whimpers in pain...

results.text: The grateful animal leads you to its hidden stash before limping away!
Your kindness fills you with warmth. Your team feels healthier!
The animal bites you in fear before running off. Good deed, painful result.
Nature is harsh. You continue on, conflicted.

events.title: Wandering Merchant
events.description: A mysterious merchant appears from the brush, their pack overflowing with unusual wares.

results.text: The merchant buys some of your extra supplies for a good price!
They trade you a bundle of rare wild herbs!
A fine truffle at a bargain! The merchant seems eager to move.
The merchant smiles mysteriously and vanishes into the wilderness.

events.title: Hidden Cache
events.description: You notice a pile of rocks that seems deliberately placed. Someone hid something here...

results.text: A buried chest contains a stash of coins! Someone's rainy day fund.
A ranger's hidden supply — capture nets!
An herbalist's cache of dried wild herbs!
The cache's owner returns... and they're not happy!
You respect the hidden stash and move on.
